product_metadata.title: Christmas Light Suction Cups [Set of 50] Window Suction Cups with Hooks - Christmas Light Clips For Mini, C6, C7, C9, Christmas Lights - Christmas Lighting Suction Cups - No Tools Required - USA Made
features: HOLIDAY LIGHT SUCTION CUP: Set of 50 premium-quality suction cups with attached clips for quickly and easily adding elaborate lights to windows. Works with c-sized bulbs (c5, c7, c9, c12) and G40 LED light ropes.

SET-UP IN SECONDS - 1: Clean the surface, then make sure the surface will stay a bit wet. 2: Firmly press cups against desired location 3: Attach light bulbs to the clips. To remove: lift the easy-release tab - Perfect for decorating pros and amateur DIY decorators alike.

POWERFUL SUCTION: USA-made strong suction cup grasps smooth surfaces firmly; won’t budge until removed & doesn’t lose adhesion overtime. Durable, break-resistant, clear plastic suction cups are yellow-proof and won’t clash with the décor.

GENTLE SURFACES: Strong, yet very gentle hold that won’t crack, scratch, or damage slick, smooth surfaces such as glass, plastic, tile, Formica, ceramic, porcelain, and acrylic. Easy-release tab makes removal convenient and just as gentle.

INDOOR & OUTDOOR USE: Our suction cup light clips stay in place inside or outside rain or shine; a perfect, practical solution for placing dazzling lights on windows, doors, vinyl siding, garage doors, and smooth fences.
